text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Page triggered — GPU pool 'hotpath-prod-1' saturation. autoscaler failed to scale for 14m, queue growth observed. Severity: P1. Paging on-call (sophie).

sophie: I'm on it. Observing sustained enqueue rate + increased 429s from edge. starting root cause triage.

rahul: I see a cascade — autoscaler logs show repeated ScaleUp blocked: 'maxPoolSizeReached' then token-bucket rejections. linking logs: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/xyz/gpu-autoscale?orgId=1

maria: Customer reports slowdowns and 429s on hosted endpoints (not all). CS alerted major customers via status page draft. @customer-success can confirm list.

customer-success: Affected customers: org-acme, org-lakeside — both have high throughput trials. We already sent an initial advisory that we're investigating.

sophie: Quick snapshot: active requests queued ~9.8k, average latency spiking to 4.2s, error-rate 429 -> 18% over last 10m. Autoscaler attempted 3 scale events, each failed with controller error: "scale request exceeds tenant limit".

ops-bot: autoscaler-controller: ERROR: request to increase pool size denied by quota service (tenant-123): limit=20 current=20

rahul: That explains part. But token-bucket rejections are still happening on the gateway before requests hit pool. Looks like rate-tier policy pinched throughput to avoid cold start cost but it's starving hotpath during surge.

sophie: Actions: 1) increase tenant GPU quota temporarily, 2) bump token-bucket burst/refill for hotpath tier, 3) enable fallback model variant (cpu-backed) for non-critical routes. Who can change quota now?

kevin: I can patch the quota service. Willing to raise tenant-123 max to 30 for 30m. Patching now.

kevin: applied patch -> kubectl exec -n controlplane quota-service -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/tenants/tenant-123/quota -d '{"gpu_pool_limit":30}'

ops-bot: quota-service: INFO: tenant-123 gpu_pool_limit updated to 30 by kevin

rahul: Meanwhile I'm going to tune token-bucket for tier 'hotpath-prod'. Current config: refill=100/sec, capacity=500. I'll change to refill=350/sec, capacity=2000 to allow bursts while autoscaler ramps.

eli: Be careful — increasing token-bucket can spike downstream cost. We should gate with a temporary surge window and monitor costs. Also set a short TTL rollback.

maria: CS: we're ok with temporary risk; need service restored. Customers are getting 429s and some support tickets are piling up.

rahul: making the change:

```
POST /config/tokens/hotpath-prod
{
  "refill_per_sec": 350,
  "capacity": 2000,
  "surge_window_sec": 900
}
```

rahul: applied. Watching metrics.

sophie: autoscaler logs now show ScaleUp accepted, new nodes provisioning. Pool target 25 -> 28 -> provisioning.

ops-bot: instance-launcher: INFO: started provisioning GPU instance i-0abc123 for pool hotpath-prod-1

eli: Gateway 429 rate dropped to 6% within 3m after token-bucket bump. Queue now 2.1k. Good sign.

kevin: Instances coming up, routing reports show new workers joining. Pool size now 28/30.

maria: Customer-impact update: org-acme saw 75% fewer errors after mitigation. Post message to status page: "Mitigation in progress; partial restoration observed." I'll send.

sophie: Marking mitigation in place. Next: longer-term fix — autoscaler should consider pending queue depth before rejecting scale due to quota; also token-bucket defaults too conservative for hotpath.

rahul: Agreed. Immediate follow-ups: - add queue-depth heuristic to scale decision (rahul) - add per-tenant emergency quota bridge (kevin) - add alert that token-bucket throttle > 5% for >5m (eli) - postmortem draft (sophie/maria)

maria: I'll coordinate comms + timeline for customers and collect affected request IDs for QA.

customer-success: Will follow up with org-acme support contacts and offer credit for impact window.

sophie: Final status: incidents mitigated at 1987654678. Autoscaler resumed normal operations and queue drained. Root causes: 1) tenant quota hit prevented scale-up, 2) conservative token-bucket config for hotpath tier amplified throttling during surge, 3) lack of queue-based scale heuristic.

sophie: Timeboxed rollbacks: token-bucket settings will revert in 30m automatically. Keeping temporary quota increase for 1h while we observe.

eli: I'll create Grafana dashboard panels for the new alerts and add short-term dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz/hotpath-mitigation

rahul: Started a PR with code changes for scale heuristic: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/merge/1234 (WIP)

maria: Postmortem owners: sophie (incident lead), rahul (root cause + fix), kevin (quota flow), eli (alerts), maria (customer comms). Draft due EOD tomorrow.

sophie: Thanks all — handing over to second shift. @rahul you're primary for follow-ups. I'm off-call.

rahul: Taking over. I'll post updates if anything else changes. Closing page for now. :white_check_mark:
